editorial: When the streets go dark and infection rises, the city turns into a maze of madness, pulling you closer with every edge‑shifting turn. It layers dread behind a pandemic, forcing you to confront terror that lurks in both virus and humanity. The soundscape drives the fear, swelling from a distant hiss to bone‑shattering screams that echo your own heartbeat. If you crave horror that makes you feel trapped behind an ever‑changing wall, this will haunt you. The atmosphere is relentless, a film that refuses to let you breathe easy.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of psychological thrillers who enjoy non-linear storytelling.
